items.stem: A RAG bot gives a confident answer that is nowhere in the retrieved passages. The right passage was retrieved. What failure is this?

options.text: Ignored context: the model answered from parametric memory instead of the retrieved passages
options.rationale: Correct: when the right context is present but unused, the model ignored it, often fixable with stronger grounding instructions.
The right passage was retrieved, so retrieval did not fail.
Chunking is not the issue when the correct passage was retrieved.
That would break retrieval entirely, which did not happen here.

items.explanation: Correct: when the right context is present but unused, the model ignored it, often fixable with stronger grounding instructions.

items.stem: Which TWO are good reasons to choose RAG over fine-tuning for a knowledge task? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The knowledge changes often and must stay current without retraining
options.rationale: Correct: RAG updates by changing the index, not the weights.

options.text: You need answers grounded in specific source passages you can cite
options.rationale: Correct: RAG supplies and can cite the exact retrieved text.

options.text: You want to permanently change the model's writing style
options.rationale: Style adaptation is a fine-tuning use case, not RAG's strength.

options.text: You want to avoid storing any documents at all
options.rationale: RAG requires storing and indexing the documents.

items.explanation: Correct: RAG updates by changing the index, not the weights.

items.stem: In the RAG pipeline, what is the purpose of the embedding step?

options.text: Convert text into vectors so semantically similar passages can be found by similarity search
options.rationale: Correct: embeddings place similar meanings near each other for retrieval.

options.text: Compress documents to save disk space
options.rationale: Embeddings are for similarity search, not primarily compression.
Generation is a later step performed by the LLM.

items.explanation: Correct: embeddings place similar meanings near each other for retrieval.
